connectors.ea.name: EA
connectors.ea.errors.invalidId: This EA game has an invalid identifier and cannot be launched.
connectors.ea.errors.launcherMissing: The EA app was not found. Install it from ea.com and try again.
connectors.ea.errors.installerDataMissin: This EA game is no longer in its folder. Scan your folders again.
connectors.ea.login.title: Sign in to EA
connectors.ea.login.body: First sign in at ea.com in your browser (with Google or with your email, as usual). Then open the link: you will see a text between curly braces. Copy all of it and press Paste. Ludiary does not store your password.
connectors.ea.error.login: EA did not accept the sign-in. Try again.
connectors.ea.error.expired: Your EA session has expired. Connect again to update your EA games.
connectors.ea.disconnect.hint: Ludiary deletes its EA session from this computer. To sign out everywhere, change your password at ea.com.
connectors.ea.error.token: That is not the EA text. If you see login_required, sign in at ea.com in your browser first, then open the link again.
